reviews.name: Cloud & Signal
reviews.premise: Telecom-calm: a bright cloud-white base, graphite type and one warm signal red, softened by a blush-to-lilac haze for glow effects.
logo_ideas: A rounded house-and-frame glyph whose roofline fades from signal red into blush
A soft 'B' built from two stacked rounded rooms with a glowing doorway

reviews.name: Launch Haze
reviews.premise: Aerospace-clean: lunar white and brushed aluminium greys, a deep ignition red used sparingly, and a dawn-mauve haze like a launch at first light.
logo_ideas: A smooth upward arc rising off a level base line, like a structure going up
A rounded monogram with a single red ignition point

reviews.name: Pastel Aurora
reviews.premise: The softest of the three: a warm porcelain base, slate type, coral red, and a peach-to-periwinkle aurora that drifts behind marks and motion.
logo_ideas: Overlapping translucent rounded tiles forming a house, coral fading through peach to periwinkle
A friendly rounded roof-and-door mark with a soft aurora glow
